reconciliation.explanation: TradRadar's seven-exchange OI is $1.95B; Alpha Finance's all-venue notional OI is $2.84B. Venue and contract coverage differ, so the $890M gap is preserved rather than averaged.
reconciliation.independence_caveat: Both dashboards rely on overlapping public exchange feeds. Similar long-liquidation shares are a cross-dashboard consistency check, not two independent observations of the same underlying trades.

prior_alpha_snapshot.interpretation: The same publisher's earlier rendered snapshot showed short liquidations exceeding longs; the later snapshot shows the reverse and substantially larger long liquidations. This vintage reversal is retained, not silently overwritten. Rolling 24-hour windows, source updates and coverage changes may contribute.

spot_cross_source_gap.interpretation: Asynchronous single-venue Kraken last and Alpha Finance spot display are not synchronized. Do not call this a contemporaneous arbitrage spread.

hypotheses.claim: A long-position unwind is a plausible contributor to the latest volatility.
support: TradRadar reports OI down 4.47% over 24 hours, 79.1% long accounts and at least $10.43M liquidations, of which $9.96M are longs.
Alpha Finance's 17:24Z view reports $11.6M long versus $528K short liquidations.
Both dashboards show approximately 95.5% of reported liquidation notional on the long side.
counterevidence_or_limitations: Underlying venue feeds overlap and the dashboards are not independent trade tapes.
Account ratios are not notional exposure.
The current Kraken API response has no exact retrieval time.
tests: Capture venue-native liquidation events, OI in contract units, funding and taker flow on a common timestamp.
Measure whether spot aggressive selling precedes or follows liquidation bursts.

hypotheses.claim: Broad risk-asset weakness may explain part of XRP's move.
support: Same-day AP reporting described sharp US equity losses and AI-sector selling; the prior market artifact preserves this as macro context.
counterevidence_or_limitations: No synchronized BTC, ETH, index futures, USD, Treasury and XRP panel in this follow-up.
tests: Build synchronized cross-asset point-in-time returns and test rolling beta and event response out of sample.

hypotheses.claim: XRP-specific spot supply or fund-related activity may be contributing.

counterevidence_or_limitations: No signed trade-flow tape, exchange-wallet flow or synchronized issuer cash-creation/redemption record is available in this capture.
ETF holdings-derived figures remain in the prior artifact and are not direct AP cash records.

hypotheses.claim: A material portion of the cross-dashboard disagreement is measurement scope and timestamp mismatch.
support: TradRadar reports $1.95B OI across seven exchanges while Alpha Finance reports $2.84B all-venue notional.
TradRadar uses seven venues for OI but five for liquidations and account ratios; Alpha's Binance map is unavailable.
counterevidence_or_limitations: Scope differences do not establish which total is closest to a true market-wide value.
tests: Reconcile contract identifiers, contract multipliers, margin currencies, venue coverage and event timestamps before aggregating.

admission.reason: Rendered spot and derivatives observations lack byte-exact receipts and independent timestamp anchors. Venue and contract universes differ; no synchronized trade-flow or historical out-of-sample evidence supports a directional call.
